note: Hand-written from PHOIBLE and the Chirp 3 HD phoneme tables; first draft 2026-10-03. Symbols are the phonemic set an entry may use; the display and the engine input share it.
conventions: Non-rhotic. Written r is ɹ only before a vowel. The goat vowel is əʊ, the nurse vowel ɜː.
also_note: Accepted by the audit though the prompts up to v4.6 do not list them: the weak vowels at the end of happy and in situation, which every learner's dictionary prints. The writers use them of their own accord, rightly.
